hero.subtitle: Permissioned ledgers, tokenization and smart-contract assurance. It stands on its own as a set of solutions, and it strengthens everything else in the portfolio by making records, assets and audit evidence tamper-proof and verifiable.

challenge.title: Why blockchain matters in the Kingdom now
challenge.body: Saudi regulators are already putting property titles, trade and food supply chains on shared ledgers. Verifiable records are becoming national infrastructure.

opportunity.title: Tamper-proof. Sovereign. Assured.
opportunity.body: Titles, certificates, contracts and audit events are anchored to a shared ledger, so any change is visible and provable. Permissioned nodes run in the client's data center or our Sovereign AI Factory, and the ledger is secured from the smart contract down to the consensus layer. The Saudi blockchain market is forecast to grow from USD 381M in 2025 to USD 38.1B in 2034.

capabilities.title: Asset Tokenization
capabilities.body: Fractional ownership and digital title transfer for real estate and other real-world assets. Aligned to the REGA tokenization sandbox and RER.

capabilities.title: Trusted Digital Records
capabilities.body: Tamper-proof registries, certificates and contracts, verifiable in seconds by any authorized party. Aligned to Vision 2030 digital government.

capabilities.title: Supply-Chain Traceability
capabilities.body: Origin-to-shelf tracking of food, pharma and goods, shared securely across trading partners. Aligned to SFDA traceability and ZATCA FASAH.

capabilities.title: Trade Finance & Settlement
capabilities.body: Smart-contract invoices, letters of credit and multi-party settlement without manual reconciliation. Aligned to the SAMA regulatory sandbox.

capabilities.title: Permissioned Enterprise Ledger
capabilities.body: Hyperledger Fabric networks and dApps hosted in-Kingdom, integrated with ERP, IAM and core systems. Aligned to NCA ECC and PDPL data residency.

capabilities.title: Blockchain Security Assurance
capabilities.body: Smart-contract audits, node security and consensus-layer reviews, before and after go-live. Aligned to NCA ECC and SAMA CSF.

applications.title: AI decisions and model versions
applications.body: Evidence from the Sovereign AI Platform, anchored to the same ledger.

applications.title: Watermark and compliance audit trails
applications.body: Audit trails from data watermarking and compliance programs, made tamper-proof.

applications.title: IoT meter and sensor readings
applications.body: Readings from IoT & Edge Intelligence, anchored as evidence.

applications.title: Predictive Operations work orders
applications.body: Work orders from Predictive DC Operations, verifiable after the fact.

applications.title: Beyond the portfolio
applications.body: Use cases extend to energy, healthcare, defence, agriculture and urban mobility.

outcomes.label: Blockchain solutions, each anchored to a Saudi priority

vision2030.body: Six blockchain solutions, each tied to a Saudi priority, from the national real estate tokenization framework to digital government.

deployment.note: Permissioned nodes run in the client's data center or our Sovereign AI Factory, aligned with NCA ECC and PDPL, and monitored by our managed SOC.

extras.title: Saudi market signals
items: Property titles on-chain: REGA and the Real Estate Registry launched national tokenization infrastructure in November 2025
Food traceability: SFDA has piloted blockchain tracing of food sources, with halal certificates recorded as tokens
Trade on a shared ledger: Saudi Customs piloted blockchain on the FASAH cross-border trade platform
Digital settlement: SAMA has tested distributed ledgers for cross-border settlement, from Project Aber to mBridge

extras.title: Commercial model
items: Entry point: a Blockchain Use-Case Assessment that selects one high-value process and proves it on a pilot ledger
Project: ledger build, smart contracts and integration
Recurring: managed nodes, contract assurance and support
